# Documentation Skill

Keep docs concise, actionable and aligned with the actual repository.
Document prerequisites, setup, scripts, architecture, data sources, decisions, testing and release workflow.
Use Spanish for owner-facing guides when appropriate.
Mark unknowns explicitly and never invent environment values or operational steps.
Never include credentials, tokens, personal data or private access links.
